sentences.text:
Title Suit No. 17 of 2017 is pending between the parties before the Civil Courts, Purnea, with regard to the land in question as has been stated by Complainant-Opposite Party no. 2 in her complaint case vide paragraph no. 3.
4.
Learned counsel for the Complainant-Opposite Party No.2 opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail and seeks time to file counter affidavit.
5. One week's time is granted for the same.
6. In the meantime, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioners in connection with Complaint Case No.1333 of 2021 pending before the Judicial Magistrate, 1 st Class, Purnea.

7. At this juncture, just after dictating the order, learned counsel for the Complainant-Opposite Party No.2 vehemently agitated and submitted that this case may be placed before any other Bench of this Court.
8. The conduct of Mr. Anuraj Singh, learned counsel appearing for the Complainant-Opposite Party No.2, being the Officer of the Court, was not at all reasonable and proper.

He did not raise any objection earlier with regard to hearing of Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.35942 of 2023(2)
dt.21-07-2023 this case by this Bench, but when the Court dictated the order in open Court granting interim protection to the petitioners since this Bench is of the opinion that the complaint case has arisen out of civil dispute
, the learned counsel for the Complainant-Opposite Party No.2 finding that the order is not in his favour showed his annoyance and prayed that the case be transferred to any other Bench.
The conduct of the counsel for the Complainant-Opposite Party no. 2 is highly deprecated.

9. However, in view of the interest of justice as also the annoying behaviour/conduct of the counsel for the Complainant-Opposite Party No.2, let this case go out of my list for placing before another Bench after taking necessary permission from Hon'ble the Chief Justice.

(Khatim Reza, J) Shanu/-
